result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign or SignWell**\. Both make it easy to send contracts, collect signatures, and keep signed documents organized without paying for an expensive enterprise platform.

However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send and whether you need features beyond signatures.

## My top 5 e-signature platforms for small businesses

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

# \$15/mo

Starting price, annual billing

- Easy to upload PDFs and send for signatures.
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans.
- Templates and document tracking.
- Integrates with Dropbox.
  
  [Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

# \$10/mo

Starting paid price, annual billing

- Very straightforward interface.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing reminders and audit trails.
- Free plan allows 3 documents per month.
  
  [Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. DocuSign**

(Best for professional business contracts)

# \$11/mo

Starting price, annual billing

- Widely recognized by customers and businesses.
- Strong document tracking and audit trails.
- Extensive integrations.
- Good for businesses expecting to grow.
  
  [Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

# \$19/user/mo

Starting paid price, annual billing

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Add pricing tables and payment options.
- Reusable templates.
- Electronic signatures built in.
  
  [Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF-heavy businesses)

# \$16.99/mo

Starting listed price

- Combines PDF editing and electronic signatures.
- Document preparation and tracking.
- Good for businesses already using Adobe.
  
  [Visit Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-sign.html)

Prices are approximate advertised starting prices as of November 2026. Billing terms, user minimums, and document limits vary by plan. Sources: [dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[helpcompare.com](https://helpcompare.com/e-signature/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, these are the features I'd prioritize\:

| Feature | Importance |
|--------|--------|
| Legally valid electronic signatures | Essential |
| Document templates | Very useful |
| Automatic signing reminders | Very useful |
| Audit trail and timestamps | Essential |
| Multiple signers | Important |
| PDF upload and editing | Important |
| Secure document storage | Important |


In the United States, look for compliance with the federal ESIGN Act and applicable state electronic-signature laws, including UETA.

## My recommendation

- **Simple contracts and agreements\:** Dropbox Sign.
- **Keep costs low\:** SignWell.
- **More established business operations\:** DocuSign.
- **Client proposals and sales agreements\:** PandaDoc.
